provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_EXTENSION_LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: In the S&P MidCap 400 + SmallCap 600 PIT universe, a long-short book that buys the least liquid quintile and sells the most liquid quintile - liquidity measured as a turnover-scaled Amihud-style illiquidity rank, sector-neutralised - earns a positive net return over 21 sessions after realistic small-cap costs.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Compensation for the expected cost of trading. An investor who must be able to exit quickly pays a premium for liquid names; the marginal holder of an illiquid name must be paid to bear exit risk. The premium is a price of a real service, not a forecast.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Not new information - a new POPULATION. The premium is measured where limits to arbitrage bind, instead of among the 500 most-arbitraged securities on earth.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Because harvesting it requires accepting the very illiquidity being paid for. Large institutions cannot size into it, so the premium is not competed away; it is structurally unattractive rather than unknown.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: The estate's LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM near-miss (lockbox t 2.89, killed by burden correction) was measured on the S&P 500. LIQUIDITY is not in the closed_mechanism_ledger for US_EQUITY at all. The population is the hypothesis.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Slow diffusion of firm-specific news. Residualising strips the market and sector components, so what remains is idiosyncratic underreaction rather than a disguised beta or sector bet.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Coverage: mid and small caps are followed by fewer analysts, so firm-specific information diffuses more slowly than in the large-cap names the estate has already mined 1,858 times.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Attention is scarce and is allocated to large caps. Nobody is paid to be the marginal informed holder of a $900m company.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: CMDY_LME_INVENTORY_STATE_CROSS_SECTION
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Ranking base metals by the trailing change in LME warehouse stocks, normalised by the metal's own inventory history, and going long the metals whose physical inventory is DRAWING DOWN against short those whose inventory is BUILDING, earns a positive net return over 21 sessions on the tradable subset.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Theory of storage. When inventory is scarce the convenience yield of holding the physical is high, the market is pushed into backwardation, and the expected return to a long futures position rises. Inventory is the state variable; the curve is only its shadow.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Inventory is a QUANTITY reported by the exchange's warehouse system, not a price. The estate has 1,621 commodity futures tests, every one of them a transformation of a quote. This series has never once entered a hypothesis.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The physical market and the futures market are populated by different participants on different timescales; producers and consumers hedge for operational reasons, not to price a risk premium, and the inventory series is published in a format nobody trades off directly.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: INVENTORY_SURPRISE_EIA is closed, but that was a US petroleum/natgas RELEASE SURPRISE in an event window. This is LME base metals, an inventory LEVEL-and-TREND state variable, and a cross-sectional rank. COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS closed the curve SLOPE LEVEL; inventory is not a curve statistic.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: The cash-futures basis is what a physical merchant is actually paid to carry the commodity. It embeds storage cost, transport constraint and local scarcity in a way a calendar spread between two paper contracts cannot.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: FUT_OPEN_INTEREST_GROWTH_CROSS_SECTION
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Ranking futures markets by the trailing growth in EXCHANGE open interest on the held contract - observed with the mandated one-session delay - and going short the markets with the fastest open-interest expansion against long the markets with contracting open interest earns a positive net return over 21 sessions.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Rapid open-interest growth means new capital is crowding into a position. Crowded positions are fragile: they need continued inflow to sustain the price, and they unwind violently. Open interest measures how much capital must eventually exit.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Real exchange open interest per dated contract, present in the R38 native layer (CL.csv carries an open_interest column across 10,897 sessions and 521 contracts) and in all 27,451 dated Norgate symbols. Twelve hypotheses have ever touched this layer, against 5,846 on the back-adjusted panel.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Open interest is published with a one-session provisional lag and is revised, so it is awkward to use and most systematic participants ignore it in favour of price.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: COT_HEDGING_PRESSURE is closed, and this must not use CFTC trader categories at all - it is total exchange open interest, a different quantity from a different publisher on a daily rather than weekly clock.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: FUT_BASIS_MOMENTUM_COMMODITY
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: The difference between the cumulative return of the front contract and that of the first-deferred contract over the trailing quarter - basis momentum - predicts the next 21 sessions of front-contract return cross-sectionally across commodity markets.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Basis momentum captures the CHANGE in the shape of the curve, which reflects the evolving imbalance between hedging demand at different maturities, rather than the static level of the carry.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: It is only computable with a genuine deferred leg. The census records that futures_panel_v1 cannot supply one; the 27,451 dated Norgate contracts can.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: It requires simultaneously maintaining two contract series per market with correct roll handling, which is an infrastructure cost most participants avoid.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS is closed on the slope LEVEL; this is the second difference - the change in the front-deferred relation - and CALENDAR_TERM_STRUCTURE_ROLL_STATE_R59 was withdrawn on ~14 effective observations, not settled on economics. The distinction must be stated in the pre-registered text and the effective-observation count must be reported up front, or the skeptic will kill it for the same reason.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_DIVIDEND_CHANGE_ANNOUNCEMENT_DRIFT
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Firms that ANNOUNCE a dividend increase or initiation - dated by declaration date, not ex-date - outperform firms announcing a cut or omission over the following 63 sessions, with entry at the next open after the declaration.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Dividend policy is sticky and management is reluctant to cut. Raising the dividend is therefore a costly, credible commitment about expected future cash flow; cutting it is a confession. The action is expensive to fake.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: The declaration date. Verified on disk to exist in the EODHD /div payload and to be carried into the record's availability stamp (JPM: ex-date 2026-07-06, declarationDate 2026-05-18 -> available_at 2026-05-18) - a seven-week gap that any ex-date-based study would have got backwards.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Dividend announcements are unscheduled, unglamorous, and scattered across the calendar; they attract none of the attention an earnings date does.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: DIVIDEND_MONTH_DEMAND_PREMIUM is closed - that is seasonal demand for yield around the ex-date, a flow story with no announcement in it. This is an information event dated by the announcement.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_SEC_COMMENT_LETTER_DRIFT
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Firms whose SEC review correspondence (UPLOAD/CORRESP) becomes public on EDGAR underperform matched non-reviewed peers over the following 63 sessions, dated by public dissemination date and entered at the next open.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: A comment letter is the regulator publicly stating that a firm's disclosure was inadequate. It raises the probability of restatement and signals lower accounting quality - information produced by an adversarial third party with subpoena power, not by the firm.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Never used in 8,445 settled hypotheses, and the release is genuinely obscure: roughly 877 UPLOAD+CORRESP filings per quarter buried inside a 352,947-row index.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The letters are released weeks after the review closes, are not covered by any newswire, and are not tagged in any commercial feed.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: DISCLOSURE_INTENSITY_R63, SEC_FILING_BEHAVIOUR_R27 and EVENT_8K_ITEM_CODES are all closed and all concern what the ISSUER chose to file. The distinguishing fact - and it must be stated verbatim in the pre-registered text - is that a comment letter is initiated by the SEC, is adversarial, and is outside the issuer's disclosure control.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: XA_TERMS_OF_TRADE_RELATIVE_VALUE
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: When a commodity-currency country's export-price basket rises relative to its own trailing history while its currency has NOT yet moved, the currency subsequently appreciates over 21 sessions; ranking the commodity currencies (AUD, CAD, NZD, and where available MXN) on this terms-of-trade-minus-FX gap produces a positive net long-short return.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: A country's export prices determine its national income and its central bank's reaction function. When the export basket moves and the currency has not, a real economic quantity has repriced and the financial claim on it has not.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: A directly measured export-price basket - RBA commodity indices available in BOTH USD and AUD (11,178 rows each, 1982-07-01..2026-08-31), plus daily physical iron ore, coal and LME metals - which lets the terms-of-trade shock be separated from the currency move itself.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The commodity and FX markets are traded by different desks with different mandates; the transmission from export prices to the currency runs through trade flows and policy expectations, both slow.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: FX_CARRY is closed AND registered forward, so the construct must be orthogonal to the interest-rate differential and must be tested as such. INTL_INDEX_TREND_FX_REVERSAL_XA_CURVE is closed - this is neither a trend nor a curve construct. The R59 frontier listed CROSS_ASSET_RELATIVE_VALUE as open and never executed it.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_EXTENSION_H5_LIQUIDITY_PROVISION_REVERSAL
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: In the extension universe, stocks with the largest 5-session decline on elevated own-name turnover reverse over the following 5 sessions, entered at the next open, and the reversal survives a doubled small-cap cost assumption.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Payment for immediacy. A seller who must exit now moves the price against themselves; whoever absorbs the inventory is compensated when the price recovers. The compensation is larger where market-making capital is scarcer.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: H1-H5 is 0.45% of the entire estate (38 tests) and equity short-horizon reversal is closed only on the S&P 500. Turnover, not signal, is the binding constraint, so the cost model is the experiment.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Providing immediacy in small caps requires balance sheet and risk tolerance that is genuinely scarce; the compensation is a real fee for a real service, not a mispricing.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: SHORT_HORIZON_REVERSAL_GAP_FADE is closed with the explicit scope qualifier '(S&P 500)'. Must be pre-registered with the doubled-cost adversarial result reported as a primary, not a footnote - a 5-session small-cap book is exactly where a cost assumption manufactures alpha.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_EXTENSION_IDIOSYNCRATIC_VOLATILITY
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: In the extension universe, stocks in the highest quintile of residual (idiosyncratic) volatility underperform the lowest quintile over 21 sessions, sector-neutral.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Lottery preference plus short-sale constraints. Investors overpay for the small chance of a large payoff, and the overpricing cannot be arbitraged away because the expensive names are the hardest to borrow. Both forces are strongest in small caps.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Population, again, plus the fact that VOLATILITY carries a search burden of 13 across the whole estate - it is the least-mined asset class we own.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The correction requires shorting small, volatile, hard-to-borrow stocks - precisely the trade that is most expensive and most career-hazardous to hold.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: No idiosyncratic-volatility family appears in the closed_mechanism_ledger for US_EQUITY; PRICE_STATE_EQUITY_FACTORS is closed on the S&P 500 panel. This is nonetheless a price-derived construct and should be treated as a lower-novelty entry, behind PH01 and PH03.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: XA_PHYSICAL_SCARCITY_TO_PRODUCER_CURRENCY
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: ONE pre-declared economic channel: a sharp drawdown in LME copper warehouse stocks predicts a 3-session appreciation of the currencies of copper-exporting economies (CLP where tradable, otherwise AUD as the liquid proxy), entered at the next available open.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: A physical scarcity shock in an exported commodity is a real-income shock to the exporting country. The transmission runs metal -> export revenue -> currency, and the currency market does not watch warehouse receipts.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: LME inventory is a physical-market quantity; the FX market prices financial flows. The two are observed by different participants, and the estate has never crossed them.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: No FX desk reads LME warehouse stocks, and no metals desk trades FX. The channel is unglamorous, the data is a warehouse report, and the horizon is too short for a macro investor and too fundamental for a fast one.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: CROSS_MARKET_PREDICTION_R33_R34 is closed as an ML SEARCH over channels (611 tests); this is ONE channel declared in advance with its sign and its economics fixed before measurement, which is the opposite procedure. INTL_INDEX_TREND_FX_REVERSAL_XA_CURVE and MACRO_EVENT_ANNOUNCEMENT_REACTION are closed and this is neither. Single-channel design also caps the multiple-testing charge at one.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: FUT_INTL_INDEX_OPEN_INTEREST_CONCENTRATION
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Across international equity index futures (FDAX, FESX, FCE, FSMI, HSI, KOS, SNK, SCN, SXF, AWM, GWM), the trailing growth in exchange open interest on the held contract predicts lower subsequent 21-session returns cross-sectionally.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: Same crowding mechanism as PH07, applied where capital flows are lumpier: international index futures are the vehicle for cross-border allocation, so open-interest expansion is a direct measure of foreign capital arriving, and arriving capital eventually leaves.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Real per-contract open interest across fifteen non-US index markets in the R38 dated layer; EQUITY_INDEX_FUTURES carries 923 settled tests, all price-state.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: Cross-border allocation decisions are made on quarterly committee cycles, so the flow is predictable in direction and slow in execution.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: EQUITY_INDEX_CROSS_ASSET_CARRY_R64 is closed - this is not carry and must not reduce to it. INTL_INDEX_TREND_FX_REVERSAL_XA_CURVE is closed - this is not trend. It is a positioning quantity. This is a SECOND application of the PH07 mechanism to a different asset class and counts against the 3-variants-per-idea limit; drop it if PH07 is running and budget is tight.

provisional_hypothesis_pool.label: EQ_H5_REVERSAL_GIVEN_SHORT_VOLUME_SHARE
provisional_hypothesis_pool.hypothesis: Short-horizon reversal is concentrated in names whose decline occurred on an unusually HIGH FINRA short-sale volume share: the reversal is stronger there over 5 sessions than in names that fell on ordinary short-sale share.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.economic_mechanism: A high short-sale share on a down day is the fingerprint of intermediated inventory absorption rather than informed selling. The market maker who shorted into the decline must buy it back, and that repurchase is the reversal.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.information_edge: Daily per-name short-sale volume share - a flow measurement that exists nowhere else for free and has entered exactly one hypothesis in the whole estate.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.why_market_may_not_fully_price_it: The file is a fixed-width text blob published after the close with no vendor packaging; using it requires an ingestion pipeline nobody builds for a 5-day signal.
provisional_hypothesis_pool.not_a_repeat_because: FAILS_TO_DELIVER_AND_SHORT_INTEREST is closed - short INTEREST is a bi-monthly POSITION snapshot; short VOLUME is a daily FLOW. CONDITIONAL AND LIKELY TO DIE: only 34 sessions exist on disk, so this hypothesis cannot be pre-registered unless data-foundation confirms and executes a free CDN backfill.

budget_recommendation.reasoning: Ten is a ceiling, not a target, and I expect to pre-register fewer. The estate has settled 8,445 hypotheses with zero survivors, so the honest prior on any single cell is very low and the only thing that changes that prior is NEW INFORMATION - which is why the budget is allocated by information source rather than by asset class. Five of the ten cells (PH04 issuance, PH05 LME inventory, PH06 physical basis, PH07 open interest, PH09 dividend declaration, PH10 comment letters - six if comment letters survive Phase 2) use a quantity or an announcement rather than a price formula, and that is the campaign's actual thesis. The 50% non-equity share is CONDITIONAL on data-foundation clearing the LME observability lag and finding a tradable metals cross-section; if that check fails, PH05/PH06/PH14 collapse together and the non-equity share must be rebuilt from PH07/PH08/PH15 on the dated futures layer alone, which would leave the campaign over-concentrated in one information source and should trigger a smaller campaign rather than a substitution. Diversity is satisfiable at 8 cells: >=3 asset classes, no class above 50%, >=40% non-equity, at least one H1-H5 (PH12, PH14), one non-equity (PH05-PH08) and one cross-asset (PH11, PH14). Two H1-H5 cells are deliberate because H1-H5 is 0.45% of the estate and is the one horizon region that is genuinely unexplored - but both must report the doubled-cost adversarial result as a primary outcome, because at 5 sessions the cost model IS the experiment. I am NOT proposing any macro-conditioned or regime-timing cell: that mechanism is dead three times and a fourth would be a contract violation. I am NOT proposing insider Form 4, 13F, 13D/G or Rule 144 despite having verified that 17 years of PIT insider data sit on disk: INSIDER_FORM4_ALL, OWNERSHIP_BREADTH_13F and CONTROL_BLOCK_13DG are closed, and a new population is not the recorded reopen condition. If Phase 2 kills the extension universe on cross-section size, the correct response is to shrink the campaign to 5-6 non-equity cells, not to backfill the slots with more price formulas.

director_notes:
The estate is not short of transformations; it is short of quantities. 97.4% of 8,445 settled hypotheses used PRICE_STATE information, and the three things I found on disk that are NOT prices are the whole of this audit's value: LME warehouse stocks (7,251 daily observations per metal, 1998-2026, never used), exchange open interest per dated contract (present in all 27,451 Norgate futures symbols and in the R38 layer, touched by 12 hypotheses out of 5,858 on futures), and the SEC's own filing record with exact filed dates (1.39 GB of company facts, 71 quarters of the full index). Those are counts of physical metal, counts of contracts and counts of shares. Nothing in the settled estate competes with them.

The second finding is about population rather than information, and it is the one I would spend the most budget on. The Norgate entitlement is far wider than what has been materialised: 'S&P MidCap 400 Current & Past' (1,765 symbols), 'S&P SmallCap 600 Current & Past' (2,644) and 'Russell 2000 Current & Past' (11,130) are all available, survivorship-safe, with PIT membership flags - while the panel actually on disk is 790 tickers of S&P 500 and nothing else. The ledger scopes two of its own US_EQUITY closures to '(S&P 500)', which tells me the previous director already understood that the extension universe reopens them by scope. The liquidity premium died in this estate at t 2.89 in the one universe where it should be weakest; that is not a refutation, it is a badly chosen sample.

The third finding is a correction I want on the record. The census says 'Form 4 parse: PROSPECTIVE-ONLY (no usable history)'. That is wrong: 69 quarters of SEC bulk insider data, 2009q1-2026q1, with exact FILING_DATE and a 10b5-1 plan flag, are on disk at alpha_agent\identity\sec_bulk\insider_transactions_data_sets. I am not proposing it, because INSIDER_FORM4_ALL is closed after 19 failed tests and a wrong availability note does not reopen a closed mechanism. But a human should know the data exists before the next census repeats the claim.

Where I would bet: not on equity. The equity work above is the highest-probability-of-a-number, but the estate is already 1,858 equity tests deep and the marginal equity result has to clear a burden denominator that equity experiments themselves inflated. The genuinely asymmetric bet is commodity physical state - inventory and the cash basis - because it is the only place where I found a deep, daily, non-price quantity that the estate has never once looked at, and because the mechanism (theory of storage) is one of the few in finance with a supply-and-demand derivation rather than a behavioural one. Its single point of failure is tradability: if only copper and the precious metals are reachable, the cross-section is too thin for a rank book and the whole lane has to become a small-N design. That is the first question I put to data-foundation, and I would rather it be answered in Phase 2 than discovered in Phase 6.

One caution I want recorded against my own enthusiasm: none of the LME, terms-of-trade or comment-letter sources has had its publication lag measured. Every one of them could be a look-ahead trap, and each is exactly the kind of source where a lag error manufactures a beautiful t-statistic. The shortlist asks for the lag before it asks for anything else, deliberately.
